tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search currently open public tenders for Ukraine's reconstruction (World Bank, EU TED, EBRD, Prozorro). Returns title (English headline), issuer, sector, region, estimated value, deadline and links to the page on Ukraine Builders and the official notice.

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Get one open tender by its id (the id field from search_tenders).

tools.name: search_contracts
tools.description: Search signed Prozorro public contracts of UAH 5 million (about US$122,000) or more in reconstruction-related categories: winner, awarding organisation, value, sector, signing date and official record.

tools.name: contract_sizes_by_sector
tools.description: Typical (median), largest and total value of the tracked signed contracts by sector, with the number of contracts, winning companies and buyers. Only contracts of UAH 5 million or more are included.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Ukraine Builders guides, upcoming World Bank and EBRD projects, tender issuers, winning companies and pages. Use it to find a guide (for example how a foreign company can bid on Prozorro) or an organisation.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List companies in the free partner directory (entries are posted by the companies themselves and are NOT verified). Can filter by what a company says it is looking for.
